What I checked:

- Before any move, I recorded the SHA-256 and byte size of all nine files (`README.md`, `members.csv`, and the seven notes).
- After the moves, each new note’s SHA-256 and byte size matched its old file: 548, 421, 914, 795, 591, 732, and 814 bytes.
- `README.md` (256 bytes) and `members.csv` (1,568 bytes) still have the same hashes.
- The seven old names are gone. The folder now holds those seven notes plus `notes/index.md`, and nothing else was added.
